station.delete_confirm: Delete {station}? Its presets, its timer and its entities go with it.
mode.manual_hint: Presets and buttons; you start the timers.
mode.power_hint: A power sensor tells when the appliance runs; the timer follows it.
presets.hint: one start button each, in this order
preset.name: Name
power.thresholds_hint: It runs above this power and has stopped once it stayed at or below it for this long (short dips are ignored; runs under 10 s do not count).
power.cancel_on_off_hint: Switching it off before the end cancels the timer.
rule.off_hint: Done when the appliance has stopped – kettle, toaster.
rule.pause_hint: Done when the power stays below a level for a while – appliances that pause when done.
rule.cycling_hint: Done when the share of time at a level within a window falls – thermostat appliances.
rule.drop_hint: Done when the power falls by a share within a time – e.g. a moka pot.
rule.knee_hint: Done when the power falls a factor faster than before – the same, independent of the level.
rule.time_hint: Done after a fixed time – only for very regular runs.
rule.energy_hint: Done after a fixed energy – only for very regular runs.
discard_confirm: Your changes on this page are not saved yet.

notice.changed: Changed elsewhere meanwhile (e.g. “Save as preset” on a dashboard). The current state is loaded – please make your change again.

notice.discarded: Unsaved changes of the page you left were discarded.
station.none_hint: A station is anything a timer belongs to – a hob, the washing machine, the bathtub.
power.sensor_hint: Sensors with the device class power, e.g. of a smart plug
power.thresholds_short: Short dips are ignored; runs under 10 s don't count.
kind.until_off_long: The timer counts up and rings when the run is done.
kind.start_preset_long: Switching it on starts a preset, e.g. rice 20 min.

rule_sentence.pause: The appliance {type}: power below {below} for {seconds} – ignore the first {ignore}.
rule_sentence.cycling: The appliance {type}: at {level} or more for less than {share} of {window} – ignore the first {ignore}.
rule_sentence.drop: The power {type} at least {percent} within {window} – ignore the first {ignore}.
rule_sentence.knee: The power {type}: over the last {window} at least {factor} as fast as in the {baseline} before – ignore the first {ignore}.
rule.all_hint: It switches off: kettle, toaster. Pauses: appliances that pause when done. Stops cycling: thermostat appliances. Falls by / falls faster: e.g. a moka pot. After a time / energy: only for very regular runs. Switch-on spikes are ignored for the first seconds.
